author: Ovigbedigitals
attribution: Photo: Ovigbedigitals, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:The_signboard_of_the_first_Primary_School_in_Nigeria.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Green stencilled panels around a painted crest on a maroon wall, Badagry. 'ST. THOMAS'' and 'SCHOOL' are on panels slanting down toward the centre. The crest repeats 'ANGLICAN NUR/PRY. / ST THOMAS / SCHOOL / BADAGRY' in blue. Alternative query: 'Badagry'.

author: e.r.w.i.n.
attribution: Photo: e.r.w.i.n., CC BY 2.0, via Flickr. Source: https://www.flickr.com/photos/51278495@N06/4811656856. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Yellow arrow-shaped street-name blade with black capitals, Abuja, seen from below. A second brown blade underneath is partly hidden: only '...PAUL II' and 'STREET' are visible (probably John Paul II Street), so it is a distractor. Small vertical photographer credit 'E.HERRERA PHOTOGRAPHY' at the left edge.

author: Friday musa
attribution: Photo: Friday musa, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Signboard_of_Commence_ommence_Nursery_and_Primary_school,_kaduna.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Hand-painted school board, Narayi High Cost, Kaduna; 'COMENCE' (spelled with one M) in shadowed blue capitals, slogan in blue script, arrow pointing right after the phone number. The crest's small text ('COMENCE NURSERY & PRIMARY SCHOOL NARAYI HIGH COST', motto) and the church board behind at left are distractors. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.
source_title: File:Signboard of Commence ommence Nursery and Primary school, kaduna.jpg

author: Habila Sani Mazawaje (Stuffedbox)
attribution: Photo: Habila Sani Mazawaje (Stuffedbox), CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Baze.university_road_signs_19.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Black stone name block with raised beige letters at the staff housing estate, Baze University, Abuja. The rusty 'SICK BAY' arrow in the foreground at right is a distractor.

author: satanoid from Austin, TX, USA
attribution: Photo: satanoid from Austin, TX, USA, CC BY 2.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:2010_shop_Lagos_Nigeria_4577324360.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Red fascia with yellow condensed letters on the right-hand shop, Lagos market street; an elephant logo at left. The small address/phone lines below and the goods list at right are blurred and not transcribed (roughly 'Block L, Shop ..., Tinubu Square, Lagos'). 'ANDEOBIH LTD' phone-shop sign and 'WURAOLA VENTURES' furniture billboard are distractors; street traders incidental.

author: James Moore200
attribution: Photo: James Moore200, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Excelture_Pharmacy.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.

lines.text: Opp Kwara Hotels, Ahmadu Bello Way, Gra,ilorin

notes: Pharmacy fascia, Ilorin; a small boxed 'EXCELTURE' logo above the large name. Address band in a serif font: 'Gra,ilorin' as printed (lower-case i, no space). A taut rope crosses the 'Opp K...' part of the address. Alternative query: 'Ahmadu Bello Way'.

author: Temilolub.52021
attribution: Photo: Temilolub.52021, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:FACULTY_OF_EDUCATION.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Blue board with weathered gold letters and two left arrows, University of Ibadan; the faded text inside the arrows is illegible. The dress-code poster at left ('FACULTY OF EDUCATION / UNIVERSITY OF IBADAN / DRESS DECENTLY ...') is a distractor.

author: Adewuyi Israel
attribution: Photo: Adewuyi Israel, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Tuyil_Pharmacy%E2%80%99s_sign_board.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Brown gate fascia of the Tuyil factory, Ilorin, small at upper left of a strongly tilted (~20 degrees) photo. A 'TIL' logo disc and a tiny 'RC: ...' registration number at left are not transcribed; the 'NO PARKING' plate by the gate is a distractor.

author: Ibraheem8088
attribution: Photo: Ibraheem8088, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Abuja_Nigeria_01.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Multicoloured letters on the castle-style gate of the Magicland amusement park, Abuja: 'Magicland' along the battlement (mixed case, playful font) and 'WELCOME' on the white arch. The COVID notices ('NO MASK NO ENTRY', 'Please Stand On The Red Marks For Social Distance', 'Wash Your ...') and the rules board are distractors; a passer-by at right is incidental.

author: Kambai Akau
attribution: Photo: Kambai Akau, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Signboard,_Customary_Court_Godogodo.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Stencilled white board with scales-of-justice emblem (middle of three roadside signs), Godogodo, Kaduna State; stencil A and U shapes are crude (the A's in 'CUSTOMARY' look like R's). A faded double arrow below. The 'EVANGELICAL REFORMED CHURCH OF CHRIST ... GODO GODO' board at left and the rusty 'PRIMARY HEALTH CARE GODOGODO' board at right are distractors.
source_categories: Photowalk in Nok, Zangon Kataf, Kafanchan, Kagoro and Godogodo

author: Kambai Akau
attribution: Photo: Kambai Akau, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Signboard,_Primary_Healthcare_centre,_Godogodo.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Rusty stencilled board, Godogodo, Kaduna State; the stencil G looks like C ('CODOCODO'). The small third line is faint and the E of 'CARE' and part of 'AREA' sit on rust patches. A painted map outline fills the middle. Same roadside as c120575555 but a different board.
source_categories: Photowalk in Nok, Zangon Kataf, Kafanchan, Kagoro and Godogodo
